extracted.name: Ground Turkey Stroganoff
extracted.description: This quick and easy ground turkey stroganoff recipe is full of comfort-food flavor thanks to cream of mushroom soup, fresh mushrooms, and egg noodles.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 (8 ounce) package fresh mushrooms, thinly sliced
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup with roasted garlic
instruction_lines: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rapid boil. Cook egg noodles at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, 7 to 9 minutes. Drain and keep warm.

Meanwhile, melt butter in a large saucepan or deep skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms, onion, and garlic; cook and stir until soft, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in ground turkey; cook until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in flour, salt, and black pepper; cook for 5 minutes. Stir in Worcestershire sauce.
Stir in condensed soup, milk, and water; bring to a simmer. Cook, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Add sour cream; stir until heated through.
